summary: Experienced preschool teacher with a decade of continuous classroom practice, skilled at designing play-based learning experiences that build early literacy, numeracy, and social skills. Known for adapting instruction to diverse developmental needs while maintaining a structured, nurturing classroom environment.

experience.title: Lead Preschool Teacher
bullets: Design and lead daily activities that teach color, shape, number, and letter recognition, personal hygiene, and social skills to a classroom of 18 students.
Establish and enforce clear behavior rules and routines, reducing daily transition disruptions by roughly 30 percent within the first year.
Adapt teaching methods and materials for students with varying needs and interests, including dual-language learners and children with individualized education plans.
Meet with guardians each quarter to discuss progress, priorities, and strategies that promote learning and development at home.
Organize games, arts and crafts, music, storytelling, and field trips that support physical, mental, and social growth.

experience.title: Preschool Teacher
bullets: Provided a variety of materials and resources for children to explore, manipulate, and use in both learning activities and imaginative play.
Served meals and snacks in accordance with nutritional guidelines and attended to basic needs such as feeding, dressing, and diapering.
Monitored developmental milestones and documented observations to inform instructional planning and guardian conferences.
Led small-group learning strategies sessions that improved letter-sound recognition scores across the classroom by an average of 25 percent.
